longTitle:
A Bill to repeal and re-enact certain enactments relating to the Malvern Hills Conservators and 
the management of the Malvern Hills, to reconstitute and rename those Conservators 
as the Malvern Hills Trust and to confer further powers on the Malvern Hills Trust, to 
make further provision in relation to the Malvern Hills, and for other purposes.
summary: Petitioning guidance, the petition template and guidance for people interested in newly deposited private bills is available under "Publications".
petitionInformation:
If you are directly and specially affected by this legislation you can petition against it.

You can submit your petition through the online portal here, email it to HLPublicBills@Parliament.uk, post it or arrange to deliver it in person.

The petition template and petitioning guidance can be found under Publications.
